name: Hedger
summary: Hedger is an Expert Advisor that implements a hedging strategy by opening opposing positions to protect existing trades from adverse market movements. It monitors open positions and dynamically creates hedge orders when certain loss thresholds or market conditions are met, aiming to limit downside risk through correlated offsetting trades. The EA manages both the original and hedge positions with configurable parameters for hedge triggers and exit logic.
summary_zh: Hedger是一个实现对冲策略的智能交易系统，通过开立反向仓位来保护现有交易免受不利市场波动的影响。当达到特定亏损阈值或市场条件时，它会监控持仓并动态创建对冲订单，旨在通过相关抵消交易来限制下行风险。
strategy_analysis: Hedger EA的核心策略是对冲，即在现有持仓出现浮亏达到预设阈值时，自动开立反向仓位以对冲风险。入场条件基于持仓的浮亏金额或比例触发，当浮亏超过设定阈值时，EA会在相关品种或反向方向开立对冲仓位。出场条件通常是对冲仓位达到盈利目标或原始仓位风险解除后同时平仓。仓位管理方面，对冲仓位的规模可以与原始仓位成比例，也可以根据用户设定的参数进行调整。资金管理依赖于对冲比例和最大对冲次数的配置，以控制总体敞口。该策略的优势在于可以有效限制单边风险，但劣势是对冲仓位本身也可能产生亏损，且在震荡行情中可能导致双向亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the Hedger EA is hedging, which automatically opens opposing positions when existing positions accumulate floating losses beyond a preset threshold. Entry conditions are triggered based on the floating loss amount or percentage of the open position, and when the threshold is exceeded, the EA opens a hedge position in the opposite direction or on a correlated instrument. Exit conditions typically involve closing the hedge position when it reaches a profit target or when the original position's risk is mitigated, sometimes closing both simultaneously. Position sizing for the hedge can be proportional to the original position or configured via user-defined parameters to control the hedge ratio. Money management relies on hedge ratio settings and maximum hedge count limits to control overall exposure. The strategy effectively limits directional risk but carries the danger that hedge positions can also accumulate losses, and in choppy markets both sides may lose.

parameters.name: HedgeTriggerPercent
parameters.description: 触发对冲的浮亏百分比阈值
parameters.description_en: Floating loss percentage threshold to trigger hedge

parameters.name: HedgeLotRatio
parameters.description: 对冲仓位与原始仓位的比例
parameters.description_en: Hedge lot to original lot ratio

parameters.name: HedgeProfitTarget
parameters.description: 对冲仓位盈利目标点数
parameters.description_en: Hedge position profit target in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 monitors all orders

parameters.name: CloseHedgeWithOriginal
parameters.description: 是否与原始仓位同时平仓
parameters.description_en: Close hedge together with original position

pros: 有效限制单边持仓的下行风险，提供系统性风险保护
自动化对冲机制避免了人工延迟，响应速度快
可配置的对冲参数提供灵活性，适应不同市场环境
对冲仓位有独立的盈利目标和出场逻辑，不完全依赖原始仓位
pros_en: Effectively limits downside risk of directional positions, providing systematic risk protection
Automated hedging mechanism avoids human delay and responds quickly to adverse moves
Configurable hedge parameters offer flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Hedge positions have independent profit targets and exit logic, not fully dependent on original positions
cons: 在震荡行情中可能产生双向亏损，原始仓位和对冲仓位同时浮亏
频繁对冲会增加交易成本（点差和手续费），可能侵蚀利润
对冲策略不产生净盈利，仅是风险管理工具，长期依赖可能掩盖策略本身的问题
如果对冲品种相关性突然变化，对冲效果可能大幅降低
cons_en: In choppy markets, both original and hedge positions can incur losses simultaneously
Frequent hedging increases trading costs (spreads and commissions), potentially eroding profits
Hedging does not generate net profit but is purely a risk management tool, potentially masking underlying strategy flaws
If correlation between hedged instruments suddenly changes, hedge effectiveness can be significantly reduced
improvements: 增加基于波动率（ATR）的动态对冲触发阈值，而非固定百分比，以适应不同市场波动环境
引入相关性监控机制，当对冲品种相关性降低时自动调整对冲比例或暂停对冲
improvements_en: Add volatility-based (ATR) dynamic hedge trigger thresholds instead of fixed percentages to adapt to different market volatility regimes
Introduce correlation monitoring mechanism that auto-adjusts hedge ratios or pauses hedging when instrument correlation weakens

risk_points: 双向持仓在极端行情下可能同时产生亏损，增加账户总风险敞口
缺乏对冲次数硬性上限检查可能导致过度对冲，账户保证金不足
risk_points_en: Dual-sided positions can simultaneously generate losses in extreme market conditions, increasing total account exposure
Lack of hard cap verification on hedge count could lead to over-hedging and insufficient margin
